name: Cross-border compliance management dashboards (Swiss private bank)

mentions.name: Cross-border compliance management dashboards (Swiss private bank)
mentions.description: This is a management information system of dashboards for cross-border compliance, built for a Swiss private bank to manage compliance considerations around serving clients across borders and residencies.
mentions.problem: Entire nationalities and residencies get quietly moved to "do not serve" lists because the regulatory cost of serving them exceeds revenue, with no public process, appeal, or notice — financial exclusion most people never see.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built cross-border compliance Management info system dashboards at a Swiss private bank.
